poll.q: Fakhar Zaman ka 127 aur tri-series trophy — Pakistan cricket ka ye comeback kaisa laga?
options: 🏆 Fakhar GOAT — final mein aisi innings hi yaad rehti hai
🔥 Team effort tha — Saad, Minhas, Hassan sab ne kamal kiya
😐 Trophy achi hai, lekin Tests mein yehi form chahiye
😴 Cricket se dil uth gaya — koi farq nahi parta

https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/z.what: Fakhar Zaman ka 127 (99 balls) — Pakistan ne 326 chase kar ke Sri Lanka ko 3 wickets se hara diya, Gaddafi Stadium mein tri-series trophy jeet li.
https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/z.why: Babar 5-ball duck par out, phir bhi team ne chase poora kiya — kyun ke Saad Baig, Minhas aur Hassan Nawaz ne pressure moments mein zimmedari li. Yehi farq hai final jeetne wali team ka.
https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/z.next: Ab Tests ka season hai: Sri Lanka ke khilaf 9 Nov se Rawalpindi mein pehla Test. Fakhar ki form white-ball se red-ball confidence mein translate hoti hai ya nahi, ye dekhna hoga.
https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/z.take: Meri take: Fakhar ne teen saal ka wait ek hi innings mein khatam kar diya — aur woh bhi final mein, jab Babar duck par gaya tha. Aisi innings par hi teams yaad rehti hain. Trophy ghar aayi hai, enjoy karo, lekin Test series mein yehi jazba chahiye hoga.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2040998/petrol.what: Diesel Rs2.29 barh kar Rs402.96, petrol Rs377.91 par unchanged — 31 Oct se 2 Nov tak.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040998/petrol.why: Diesel barhne ka matlab sirf pump par zyada bill nahi — transport, sabzi, aur har woh cheez jo truck par aati hai, sab mehenga hone ka rasta khulta hai. Petrol rukna achi khabar hai, lekin diesel ka asar har ghar tak pohanchta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040998/petrol.next: Daily pricing mechanism ke tehat agli revision jald aayegi; JI ne mid-November tak levy relief na mila to Islamabad march ki dhamki di hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2040998/petrol.take: Meri take: Petrol unchanged rakh kar hukoomat ne bike walon ko thori relief di, lekin diesel walon ka bojh aakhir mein aam aadmi hi uthata hai. Fuel prices ka ye daily khel ab har hafte ki tension ban gaya hai — koi stable plan nazar nahi aata.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041321.what: LPG official Rs294/kg, cylinder Rs3,470 — lekin open market mein Rs630/kg tak bik raha hai, aur marketers 16 Nov se strike ki dhamki de rahe hain.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041321.why: 70% LPG Iran se aata tha, border band hai, to shortage hai. Lekin official aur market price mein dogna farq shortage se zyada, black market aur weak enforcement ki kahani lagta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041321.next: 16 Nov ki strike deadline aur nayi LPG policy — agar private sector ko side-line kiya gaya to sardiyon mein crisis aur gehra ho sakta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041321.take: Meri take: Sardiyan sir par hain aur gas ka cylinder aam aadmi ki pohanch se bahar ho raha hai — ye numbers nahi, gharon ki kahani hai. Policy committee aur deadline se pehle logon ko fori relief chahiye, warna har sardi yehi drama dobara hoga.

https://www.medicalnews.pk/31-Oct-2026/p.what: PMA ki 1–2 Nov mulk-gir strike: OPDs, elective surgeries aur diagnostics band; government hospitals ki emergency khuli rahegi.
https://www.medicalnews.pk/31-Oct-2026/p.why: Doctors ke mutalbat — FBR/POS pressure, criminal FIRs, workplace security — ek din ke nahi, mahinon ke gusse ka natija hain. Lekin strike ki qeemat mareez chukate hain, ye bhi sach hai.
https://www.medicalnews.pk/31-Oct-2026/p.next: Agar 2 din mein baat na bani to PMA 28 Nov ko agla course of action decide karega — matlab ye aakhri dafa nahi ho sakta.
https://www.medicalnews.pk/31-Oct-2026/p.take: Meri take: Doctors ki baat mein dum hai — kisi doctor par criminal case sirf is liye nahi hona chahiye ke treatment ka natija kharab nikla. Lekin OPD band hone se gaon ke mareez sab se zyada takleef uthate hain. Hukoomat ko table par aana chahiye, is se pehle ke ye strike routine ban jaye.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041303.what: ECP ne Kasur aur Qamber-Shahdadkot mein khawateen ki voter registration ke liye pilot shuru kiya — target taqreeban 175,000 khawateen.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041303.why: Pakistan mein khawateen ki voter registration ka gender gap ek purana masla hai: CNIC na hona = vote na hona. Door-to-door aur mobile vans isi gap ko bharne ki koshish hain.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041303.next: November mein data collection, phir Dec–Feb registration — agar pilot kaam kar gaya to is model ko pooray mulk mein phailana chahiye.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041303.take: Meri take: Ye choti khabar lagti hai, lekin asal mein bari hai — vote ka haq CNIC se shuru hota hai. Har khatoon ka naam voter list mein hona jamhooriyat ki bunyad hai, aur is kaam mein der nahi honi chahiye thi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041294.what: IAEA report: Pakistan ne isotope-based nuclear techniques se groundwater tracking mazboot kar li — Pinstech ki facility region ki advanced facilities mein se ek.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041294.why: Pakistan ka paani zameen ke neeche chupa hai aur tezi se khatam ho raha hai. Baghair sahi data ke na over-extraction pakri ja sakti hai, na salinity ka pata chalta hai — ye science ab policy ka hissa ban rahi hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041294.next: Isotope data ko national water models mein shamil kiya ja raha hai; agla step ye hai ke is data par sakht faislay hon — warna report sirf report reh jayegi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041294.take: Meri take: Ye woh khabar hai jo headline nahi banti, lekin 10 saal baad sab se zyada farq isi se parega. Paani ka masla naare se nahi, data se hal hoga — aur achi baat ye hai ke Pakistan is mein peeche nahi raha.

https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/30/apple-con.what: Apple Intelligence aakhir China mein — 4 Nov se beta testing, December mein iOS 27.3 ke saath public release, Alibaba ke Qwen model ke saath.
https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/30/apple-con.why: China duniya ka sab se bara iPhone market hai aur 2 saal se AI features se mehroom tha. Regulators ki manzoori ke baghair Apple wahan AI launch nahi kar sakta tha — is liye local partner (Alibaba) zaroori tha.
https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/30/apple-con.next: 4 Nov ki beta batayegi ke Qwen integration kitna smooth hai; Siri AI abhi bhi China mein nahi aa raha, us ka timeline baad mein aayega.
https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/30/apple-con.take: Meri take: Apple ne China mein jeetne ke liye apna rule tor diya — apne ecosystem mein doosri company ka model. Ye compromise hai, lekin samajhdaar compromise: market itni bari hai ke usay ignore nahi kiya ja sakta. Baqi duniya ke liye sabak ye hai ke AI ab har mulk ke apne rules se chalega.

https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/01/b.what: OpenAI ne funding target $10B ghata kar ~$20B kar diya, valuation $1.4T se $1.25T par aa gayi — investors ne allocations kam kar di.
https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/01/b.why: AI par arabon kharch ho rahe hain, lekin investors ab pooch rahe hain ke paisa kab wapas aayega. Jab market gir rahi ho to sab se bari company ko bhi discount dena parta hai.
https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/01/b.next: First close $20B se kam hone ki umeed hai; OpenAI ki 2027 listing aur Anthropic ke IPO se pehle ye round band karna us ke liye zaroori hai.
https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/01/b.take: Meri take: Ye OpenAI ke khatme ki khabar nahi, hype ke normal hone ki khabar hai. $1.25 trillion bhi koi choti valuation nahi — lekin ye din yaad rakhna: jab investors ne pehli baar AI ki kahani par hisab manga.

https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/142191.what: Alphabet ek din mein 12% gira, $500B market value gayab — apni hi AI search ne ad revenue kha liya.
https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/142191.why: Google ki kamai ka asal engine search ads hain. AI Mode user ko direct jawab de deta hai, to woh ads par click nahi karta — growth 19% se 12% par aa gayi, cash flow negative ho gaya.
https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/142191.next: Google ab AI Mode mein ads daalne ki koshish kar raha hai, lekin sawal ye hai ke users AI jawab ke beech mein ad bardasht karenge ya nahi.
https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/142191.take: Meri take: Ye tech history ka sab se ironic moment hai — Google ne apne haathon apna sab se bara business kharab kiya, kyun ke agar woh na karta to koi aur kar deta. 'Eat your own lunch' wali baat sahi hai, lekin lunch $500B ka tha — investors ko ye hazam nahi ho raha.

https://www.androidpolice.com/gemini-cre.what: Gemini mein ab Docs, Sheets, Slides aur PDFs chat ke andar hi banao, preview karo aur edit karo — bina app chhore.
https://www.androidpolice.com/gemini-cre.why: ChatGPT aur Copilot ye kaam mahinon se kar rahe the; Google peeche tha. Ab Gemini chat sirf baat-cheet nahi, poora workspace ban raha hai.
https://www.androidpolice.com/gemini-cre.next: Dekhna ye hai ke log chat mein file edit karna pasand karenge ya asli Docs app mein hi wapas jayenge — aur mobile par Docs/Sheets editing kab aayegi.
https://www.androidpolice.com/gemini-cre.take: Meri take: Achi feature hai, lekin der se aayi. Students aur office walon ke liye ye waqei kaam ki cheez hai — assignment ya report chat mein ban jaye, edit ho jaye, export ho jaye. Google ko ab isay mobile par bhi poora lana hoga, warna aadha kaam hi reh jayega.

https://www.techinasia.com/news/deepseek.what: DeepSeek ka 'super-agent': group chat mein bug report ho to AI khud defect dhoondhe aur fix karne ki koshish kare, bina tag kiye.
https://www.techinasia.com/news/deepseek.why: Coding agents ab sirf code likhne se aage ja rahe hain — poori team workflow sambhalne ki taraf. DeepSeek ne ise open-source bhi kar diya, jo is race mein us ka signature move hai.
https://www.techinasia.com/news/deepseek.next: Internal instance pehle se chal raha hai; asal test ye hai ke ye system production code mein kitne fixes sahi karta hai aur kitne naye bugs banata hai.
https://www.techinasia.com/news/deepseek.take: Meri take: Ye future ki jhalak hai — AI jo sirf tumhare kehne par nahi, khud dekh kar kaam kare. Darawna bhi hai, dilchasp bhi: agar AI bina pooche code change kare to zimmedari kis ki? Ye sawal abhi se poochna hoga, baad mein nahi.

https://kimkj.com/en/ai-board-en/?mod=do.what: Xiaomi ne 800M-parameter OCR model open-source kar diya; China ki humanoid shipments 97% global share par; chips ki rukawat software ecosystem hai.
https://kimkj.com/en/ai-board-en/?mod=do.why: China ab sirf bare models ki race nahi, chote efficient models + robots + poora ecosystem ki race khel raha hai. Open-source us ki strategy ka hissa hai — duniya ko apne tools par build karwana.
https://kimkj.com/en/ai-board-en/?mod=do.next: 18 humanoid companies listing ki taraf — agar robots real duniya mein 80% tasks na kar sake to ye investment bubble bhi ban sakta hai.
https://kimkj.com/en/ai-board-en/?mod=do.take: Meri take: West bari models par lar raha hai, China chote models aur robots par chup-chap aage nikal raha hai. 97% shipments koi chota number nahi — ye woh jagah hai jahan agle 5 saal ki asli race hogi, aur hum sirf dekh rahe hain.

mood: 🏆 Fakhar ka 127, diesel-LPG ki mehngai aur AI market ka $500B jhatka — aaj khushi aur tension dono hain.
